															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.
															
															
														 
														
														

	
	📋 How to Apply RRC Southern Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026 for 4471 Post

	
		Visit the official website sr.indianrailways.gov.in or RRC Chennai portal rrcmas.in.
		Go to News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information and click the Act Apprentice 2026 / Apply Online link.
		Complete New Registration using a valid Mobile Number and Email ID.
		Log in and fill personal, educational (10th + ITI), trade and category details carefully.
		Upload Photo, Signature, 10th Marksheet, ITI Certificate and other required documents.
		Pay the application fee online (if applicable) and submit the form.
		Download / Print the submitted application and keep the Registration Number safe.
	

	Note: Apply Start Date – 28-08-2026 | Last Date – 27-09-2026 (05:00 PM). Apply early to avoid last-minute server issues. Check all details before final submit.

															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification

															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification

															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.

																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															RRC SR Apprentice 2026: Trade Wise Educational Qualification
															
														
														
															
															Trade Nme
															
															
															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman (Civil) & Mech.R&AC
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
															
															
														
														
															
															Note: 

															i) Minimum 50% marks in X std is not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD Candidates. 

															ii) Course Completed Act Apprentices, Engineering Graduate or Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder who had training or job experience for a period one year or more, after the attainment of these qualifications are NOT eligible for being engaged as trade apprentice under the Act Apprentice Rules 1992.
															
														
														
															
															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:-  Fresher’s - X std Rs.6000/- (per month)  ||  Fresher’s - 12th std Rs.7000/- (per month) ||   Ex-ITI Rs.7000/- (per month)
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															Education Qualification
															
														
														
															
															 Fresher Category
															
														
														
															Fitter, Painter & Welder
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent.
															
															
														
														
															Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology, Pathology, Cardiology)
															
															
																Should have passed 12th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
															
															
														
														
															
															Ex-ITI Category

																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electrician
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science as one of the subjects or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade.
															
															
														
														
															Electronics Mechanic
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education with Science (Physics and Chemistry) and Mathematics or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Secretariat Assistant & Stenographer (English)
															
															
																Should have Passed 12th Class examination under 10+2 system of education or its equivalent and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance
															
															
																Should have Passed 10th Class examination under 10+2 system of education and passed ITI Course in the relevant trade in Government recognized ITI and should possess certificate issued by the National Council for Vocational Training or State Council for Vocational Training in the respective trade
															
															
														
														
															COPA/PASSA
															
															
																Should have passed 10th Class (with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks) under 10+2 System of education & National Trade Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant
